entities.name: Andrzej Wawrzyniak
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andrzej Michał Wawrzyniak was a Polish sailor, diplomat, connoisseur and collector of Oriental art, and founder, lifetime director, and chief curator of the Asia and Pacific Museum in Warsaw.
